answer: Each identity escrows 22 POA for 21 epochs and signs 12 beacon-timed receipts. A zenith committee of 9 auditors replays 6 samples. Shared funding or hosts form one voyage cluster; member k owes 22*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 22*(2*k-1). The wander ledger rejects reused work; two failures burn all cluster bonds and bar its keys for 17 epochs.
